[[File:Detective Pikachu Returns local concerns.png|thumb|Concerns list in Detective Pikachu Returns]] '''Local concerns''' (Japanese: '''みんなの困りごと''' ''Everyone's Problems'') are a feature introduced in [[Detective Pikachu Returns]]. These are small optional tasks that local residents, including Pokémon, will ask [[Tim Goodman|Tim]] and [[Detective Pikachu (character)|Pikachu]] for assistance in finding a solution. These are detailed in a separate concerns list, which can be accessed by pressing the Y button. When these tasks are completed, newspaper articles will talk about events based on said tasks. The game's prologue and final chapter (A Plan That Transcends Time) feature no local concerns. ==List of local concerns== ===The Missing Jewel=== {| class="roundy" style="background:#{{electric color}}; text-align:center; border:3px solid #{{electric color light}}; margin-top: .8em" ! width=20%; style="background:#{{electric color light}}; {{roundytl|5px}}" | Local concern ! width=30%; style="background:#{{electric color light}}" | Description ! width=25%; style="background:#{{electric color light}}" | Solution ! width=10%; style="background:#{{electric color light}}" | Location ! width=25%; style="background:#{{electric color light}}; {{roundytr|5px}}" | Newspaper article |- style="background:#FFFFFF;" | [[File:DPR 1st local concern.png|200px]]
